text:
Leah Carter: Heads-up: weekend activation for Acme trial—planning warm pools + client-side prefetching. Wanted a quick checklist so CS/SEs can run the go-live. Please add anything I miss.
Samir Patel: love it. can we limit prefetch window to 5m per tenant? avoids double-warm.
Leah Carter: yes — recommended pattern: client prefill for top-3 prompts only, server-side prefix cache TTL=10m, KV cache warm with `seed_prompts.json` during pool spin-up.
Jordan Kim: for batching, set batch_window=6ms for low-latency routes; 30ms for background enrichment. also enable adaptive batching under heavy surge.
Mia Alvarez: streaming fallback note: if first-byte > 250ms then switch to immediate non-stream path (clients expect 1st token quickly). docs have sample header: `X-Stream-Policy: prefer_stream|fallback_immediate`.
Leah Carter: ops checklist: 1) spin warm pool (3 GPUs) 2) deploy seed prompts 3) run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood/.../warmcheck` 4) monitor `prefill_hit_rate` and `latency_p50` in Console.
Samir Patel: telemetry thresholds: prefill_hit_rate > 60% within 5m, latency_p50 < 120ms, error_rate < 0.5% — if not, rollback warm pool and open a CS/Eng bridge.
Jordan Kim: add note for renewals: if trial tenant shows repeated low prefill_hit_rate + rising cost per token, flag as "engage early" in Gainsight with tag `warmup-risk`.
Mia Alvarez: customer message snippets for enablement call: "We'll prefill your top flows to reduce wait time. Please share 3 sample prompts and expected responses." keeps it simple.
Leah Carter: on collecting feedback: set a short post-go-live survey sent 1 hour after first live session: 3 Qs (latency good? accuracy ok? anything missing?). link: https://forms.gle/example
ops-bot: Scheduled warm pool job started for tenant acme-123 at 2024-05-18T02:00Z :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded on model-rev v3.2.1 — no rollback triggered
Samir Patel: last ask — add a fallback routing policy: if dedicated pool < 70% capacity, route to hosted read-only variant with note to customer (reduce features like tools/calls).
Leah Carter: perfect. I'll convert this into a one-page runbook and attach to the customer record. tagging @Jordan Kim for batching params and @Mia Alvarez for enablement script.
Jordan Kim: sending batch config snippet in #eng-platform after lunch
Mia Alvarez: I'll draft the customer email and share in the thread later :thumbsup:
Leah Carter: thanks team — aiming to start handoff at 08:00 PT tomorrow. if anyone can't attend, ping now.
